top_signals.title: Wheat Drops to Two-Week Low Ahead of US Supply, Demand Report
top_signals.summary: Wheat hit its lowest in two weeks as grain futures were mixed amid geopolitical turmoil and the ahead of the Friday release of a monthly supply and demand report from the US Department of Agriculture.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
